result:
Round 271 **PASSES**. I checked A's change myself in real Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720, against both the new build and my own copy of HEAD `4b912a9`. No source file changed while I worked, and I made no app edits.

**The behaviour Saba asked for works in the browser, at both sizes:**
- **Small jitter no longer moves a clip.** I put a clip at 10.300 and dragged it 5 px each way. It stays at 10.300, the status reads "Move clip: nothing changed — the Undo history is unchanged." and Undo is unchanged. HEAD still jumps it to 10.000.
- **An off-grid clip keeps its offset.** It moves 10.300 → 11.300 → 12.300, and two Undos bring it back to 10.300.
- **Moving to another track keeps it too.** The drag ghost reads 13.300 and the clip lands at 13.300 on Stems (HEAD: 13.000).
- **Group drag:** 11.300 / 16.000, status "2 clips moved 00:01.000 to the right." (HEAD: 12.000 / 16.700).
- **These still work as before:** an on-grid drag (11.000), a left-edge trim (lands on the line at 14.000), the arrow-key nudge (11.000, Undo back to 10.300) and the three Snap button tooltips.
- **The exported audio follows.** I exported a WAV with the clip at 10.000 and again at 12.300. The second file is exactly 2.3 s later: every sample matches after the shift and there is silence before 12.3 s.

**Other rows that pass:**
- **Scope:** only the 9 allowed files changed, and the four existing snap functions are untouched.
- **Claims:** B's grep claims K1–K13 match.
- **Tests:** the 7 targeted test files pass, 197/197; the slowest test is 833 ms.
- **Rewritten tests:** every old check that changed was replaced with a check on the same thing; none was just deleted.
- **Mutants:** every planned code mutation turns tests red, run with my own script on a separate copy.
- **Screen space:** no new on-screen text.
- **Login is not bypassed:** the demo page opens with no sign-in. The product studio page shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio. The token endpoint returns 401 with no login and 500 with a fake one, and neither returns a token.
- **Docs:** both implementation docs have the exact status line, and the lesson the task relies on exists (L45/L46).

I didn't claim the full test suite, build, verify or e2e smoke; the root gate runs those.

**Ableton comparison:**
- Clips snapping to the grid and to other clips' edges, and Alt to bypass snap: confirmed in the Live 12 manual, as cited by B. I didn't re-open the manual.
- An off-grid clip keeping its offset: not confirmed by any source; this is Saba's decision, and root's Live measurement request is still open.
- How the arrow nudge should treat an off-grid clip: still a question for Saba.

F1-ABSOLUTE-SNAP and R49-T part 1 can close.

**For B (none of these change the verdict):**
- **C-R271-01 (Low, also at HEAD):** after a successful arrow nudge, the clip is at 11.000 but the status line still says "Move clip: start 00:10.300". The nudge never writes a status. It fits round 272 (SYS-6 status lifetime) or the deferred Low list.
- **Test gap (info):** one fallback step for a blocked group move on a musical grid is not covered by any test. If that line is removed, all tests still pass.
- **Cache side effect (info):** my scratch copies shared the store's `node_modules`, so they rewrote the store's Vite and vitest cache (not tracked by git). The :5173 server stayed healthy and no tracked file changed. A and B use the same setup.
